- **requirement-docs** — the house standard for requirement analysis / PRD "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"/ design docs; output is archived to `docs/requirements-and-design/`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"1. **Install** — have an agent run it in any session, or use the Web plugin management page:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Or install from a local checkout (link mode; after an update, `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle` aga"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"nstall from a local checkout (link mode; after an update, `remove_bundle` + `install_bundle` again):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Or with the `dsh` CLI in a terminal — pick the profile matching how you run it:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"2. **Restart DSH** — quit the app completely and reopen it (a page refresh doesn't count); only then"},{"id":"p20s2","text":" does the client module table recognize the bundle."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"3. **Configure** — Settings → dsh-switchman, or "Switchman Dispatch Center" in the home sidebar. [该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- The host half (`index.js` + `host/`) injects the byte-stable system-prompt sections (language / la"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"nes / watermark protocol / teams) plus the live watermark line through the tail runtime-context snap"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"shot (a channel that appends instead of rewriting the prompt head, so the provider prompt cache stay"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"s intact), the read-budget plus enforce double gate, and four slash commands (the ctx trio + `/visio"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"n`). A saved setting takes effect at the very next prompt assembly — no restart.
- The client half ("},{"id":"p24s6","text":"`client.js`) renders the settings page, the ⚡ badge and ◇ model marker in the session header, and th"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"e live handover indicator; config snapshots are read and written through the Host route family.
- Th"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"e "Switchman Dispatch Center" entry in the home sidebar opens that same settings page as a center pa"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"nel in one click; the original settings entry stays.
- `cordis.patch.yml` keeps the factory preset p"},{"id":"p24s10","text":"lugin list fully intact and only extends the persona suffix; the Agent Teams tools themselves come f"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"rom the factory bundle and switch on automatically with teams mode."}],"truncated":true}
